Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

punkstR 0.99.2

Bug fixes

  • punkst_topic_model() no longer requires a .state.tsv output: the released punkst binary (v0.1.2) never writes it (that output was added to fit_lda.cpp only after the v0.1.2 tag), so requiring it made the vignette and CI tests fail on every supported install. state is now included in the returned files only when the punkst build in use actually produced it, and the punkstModel validator no longer requires it.
  • Fixed CI so the vignette and all @examples genuinely execute (rather than silently skipping) during R CMD check, and the testthat suite runs with zero skips.

punkstR 0.99.0

New features

  • Initial release: a thin, system2()-based R driver for the punkst spatial transcriptomics pipeline (no reticulate, no Python imported into R).
  • check_punkst_setup() locates the punkst binary and a Python interpreter with spatialdata installed.
  • sdata_export() exports SpatialData (zarr) points elements to the transcript format punkst expects.
  • Formal S7 classes model the pipeline stages: punkstConfig, punkstStage (and its punkstTiles/punkstHex/punkstModel subclasses), and punkstRun.
  • Stage wrappers (punkst_tiles(), punkst_hex(), punkst_topic_model()) and a one-call run_punkst_pipeline(), with manifest-based skipping of stages that are already up to date.
  • Result readers: punkst_read_model(), punkst_read_topics(), punkst_read_hex(), punkst_read_features(), match_xy().
  • sdata_writeback() writes a run’s hexagon shapes and topic results back into a SpatialData store (new sidecar store by default, or in place); sdata_runs() lists stored runs; punkst_compare_runs() compares two runs’ topic loadings (and, when grids match, per-hexagon topic agreement) without needing Python.
  • sdata_demo() builds a small synthetic SpatialData store for the package’s vignette and examples.

Bioconductor submission readiness

  • Version set to the 0.99.0 new-submission convention; added biocViews, URL, BugReports, SystemRequirements to DESCRIPTION.
  • Added @examples to all exported functions and classes, guarded with tryCatch() where they need the punkst binary or a spatialdata-enabled Python so they degrade gracefully instead of erroring when those aren’t present.
  • Fixed a latent bug in punkst_compare_runs() where the per-hexagon agreement computation ran outside the try() meant to make it optional.
  • Added a GitHub Actions workflow (R-CMD-check.yaml) running R CMD check and BiocCheck on every push/PR, installing a real Python environment (numpy/pandas/scipy/spatialdata) and a prebuilt punkst binary so the vignette and examples actually run in CI rather than being skipped.
